comment: GENERATED by hack/mkg catalog from knowledge/packs and knowledge/sources. Do not edit.

node_boot_time_seconds.help: Boot time as a unix timestamp (use it to detect reboots).

node_cpu_frequency_hertz.collector: cpu, needs `--collector.cpu.info` (only if cpufreq is off or uses its prefix)

node_disk_device_mapper_info.labels: device, name, uuid, vg_name, lv_name, lv_layer

node_disk_info.labels: device, major, minor, path, wwn, model, serial, revision, rotational

node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total.help: Weighted busy time (queue depth). **Root** (NodeDiskIOSaturation: rate > 10 for 30m)

node_disk_read_time_seconds_total.help: Time spent on reads (use with reads_completed for latency).

node_filefd_allocated.help: Allocated FDs system-wide. **Root** (NodeFileDescriptorLimit: allocated/maximum > 70% warning, > 90% critical)

node_filesystem_avail_bytes.help: Space available to non-root users. **Root** (NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp / AlmostOutOfSpace)

node_filesystem_device_error.help: 1 if statfs failed for the mount.

node_filesystem_mount_info.help: Labels are device, major, minor, mountpoint. Mount info.

node_filesystem_readonly.help: 1 if mounted read-only (used as a guard in alerts).

node_md_state.labels: device, state (active, inactive, recovering, resync, check)

node_memory_Buffers_bytes.help: Used by the node-mixin memory rule and dashboards.

node_memory_Cached_bytes.help: Used by the node-mixin memory rule and dashboards.

node_memory_MemFree_bytes.help: Used by the node-mixin memory rule and dashboards.

node_memory_Slab_bytes.help: Used by the node-mixin memory rule and dashboards.

node_network_receive_frame_total.help: Frame, length, over, and CRC errors.

node_network_receive_nohandler_total.help: Packets dropped because there was no protocol handler.

node_network_transmit_carrier_total.help: Carrier, aborted, heartbeat, and window errors.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_drop.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_early_drop.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_found.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_ignore.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_insert.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_insert_failed.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_invalid.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_nf_conntrack_stat_search_restart.help: Per-kernel conntrack stat counters, summed over CPUs. insert_failed and drop mean the conntrack table is full or racing.

node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total.help: "some" CPU: time processes waited for CPU.

node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total.help: "full" IO: time no process could make progress because of IO.

node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total.help: "some" IO: time processes waited on IO.

node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_tot.help: "full" memory: time no process could make progress because of memory.

node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_tot.help: "some" memory: time processes waited for memory.

node_processes_max_processes.help: pid_max. PID exhaustion is pids / max_processes.

node_processes_state.help: Processes per state (R, S, D, Z, ...). Useful for D-state and zombie detection.

node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total.help: Time tasks spent waiting on the runqueue for this CPU. This is a scheduler latency signal.

node_scrape_collector_success.help: 1 if the collector succeeded. Use this to detect broken collectors.

node_systemd_service_restart_total.help: Restart triggers. Needs `--collector.systemd.enable-restarts-metrics`. Used by NodeSystemdServiceCrashlooping.

node_systemd_unit_state.labels: name, state (active, activating, deactivating, inactive, failed), type
node_systemd_unit_state.help: 1 for the current state. **Root** (NodeSystemdServiceFailed: state="failed" == 1). Covers kubelet, containerd, and similar units.

node_time_seconds.help: System time (compare with the scrape timestamp for skew).
